what_is_refused: Deriving depth order from jersey number, experience or salary
why: A jersey number is a marketing choice. This session's read shows why it breaks: the Packers chart prints '0 Matthew Golden' and '9 Christian Watson' as two different WR rows — the numbers order nothing.
instead: Store the club's own row and the club's own label; refuse to name a starter the club did not name.

why: ROI needs prices the project does not have, and a short-run ROI is a description of variance, not a test of skill.
instead: Benchmark-relative proper scores with a game-clustered lower bound and a multiplicity adjustment; staking reported separately.

what_is_refused: Any backtest number on the leaderboard
why: Once a backtest sits on the board, every later choice is contaminated by it.
instead: Pre-registration commit as the registration; prospective rows only.

what_is_refused: Subtracting a fixed number of points for a missing starter
why: A fixed penalty is a guess with the confidence of a constant.
instead: Ablations: the same model with and without verified availability features, chronological holdout, difference published with uncertainty.

why: The official report publishes no percentages; inherited folklore values are unauditable.
instead: Measure play rate per designation against inactive lists, publish the interval, then decide whether the label earns model space.

what_is_refused: Multiplying marginal probabilities to price a parlay or combo
why: Invalid under dependence; two 0.50 legs can be nearly certain or nearly impossible together.
instead: A joint estimate measured from settled pairs, plus the operator's void/push rules, or no combo is ranked.

what_is_refused: Transcribing a depth chart out of an image by eye
why: It is unverifiable, unreproducible, and it will be quoted later as if it were sourced.
instead: Record 'no machine-readable chart at this route' and leave the cells blank; ask for an authorised structured source.

what_is_refused: Scheduled automated capture before the rights question is answered
why: Automation changes the character of the use, and the terms reading the packs relied on restrict systematic non-personal use.
instead: One manual, dated, hashed read per page per session until T01 is decided; then build the cadence job the owner approves.

what_is_refused: Calling column 1 of a depth chart 'the starter'
why: This session's read shows a safety listed in two rows and three separate WR rows; there is no single rank-1 per position to promote.
instead: Model slots as groups; where a club names two players at the same rank, publish two.

what_is_refused: Filling a replacement from inference when the source leaves it blank
why: The blank is information: nobody has announced the replacement.
instead: Announced-starter evidence only, with its date and page; keep the inferred candidate in a separate, clearly labelled field if at all.

what_is_refused: Publishing a correlation without its n and its source rows
why: A coefficient computed over an unstated sample is decoration.
instead: Compute only from official numbers, publish n, and label measurement versus proposal.

what_is_refused: Letting a new pack open a 17th suggestion register
why: Sixteen registers with different schemas is why this board exists; each new one raises the review cost of every decision.
instead: Extend this board's source registers, or file a request on COORDINATION.md.
